singleDescriptor.package: one --pa-entry path for review/start/status/stop and output; rc/argv/cwd recorded
singleDescriptor.hash: descriptor.sha256 equals the executed file bytes and entries.review.sha256; mismatch throws descriptor_mismatch
singleDescriptor.overrides: source with --pa-entry or package with --start-entry/--review-entry exits 2 usage; no silent consumer
singleDescriptor.defaultNotExecuted: a default file that was not executed is never reported as the consumer

packageIdentity.reviewBinding: package restoredReviewIdentity(file) equals health.restoredReviewDigest and instance apiArgv path
packageIdentity.missingOrForeign: missing pid/start, changed state/install, wrong review argv/digest or foreign ready port leaves bound=false and fails
packageIdentity.reuse: live same-file REUSED keeps original pid/start/digest, cleanup owned=false/reused-left-running
packageIdentity.positive: exact 0ede stage: fresh verified-flow bound=true, cleanup pa-stop-verified; reuse reused; narrow/missing selection BLOCKED with original pid unchanged

cleanup.ownedFresh: pa stop on the same descriptor/rootArgs, then status STOPPED, record pid gone and supervisor exited before stopped=true
cleanup.failure: stop failure/timeout/unknown or live pid becomes status failed/verified=false exit 1 via applyCleanupOutcome, with review/state preserved
cleanup.distinctModes: reused-left-running and kept-running are not reported as stopped
cleanup.tests: real package stop verified plus unit cases for stop success/failure/reuse/keep/observed

exactPackage.flow: first-run -> pa review-restored -> pa start (foreground supervisor) -> health/sources/Work/delivery -> pa stop
exactPackage.business: chat/candidate prepare 422; provider request count unchanged
exactPackage.installedClaim: not claimed; E must bind the reported entry hashes to this tar subject

aManifest.reader: A independent reader fixture in a separate Node PID verified the same manifest
aManifest.subject: one real Store: Work/Ticket/attempt/contract/epoch, Broker question/answer/native_applied, SDK candidate, confirmed receipt, context binding/frozen body, written/indeterminate dispatch
aManifest.scope: real A source and A storage on the same Store; no second producer, SQL writer or execution lifecycle

dualFormatRestore.restore: each snapshot's database/artifacts staged -> portability createBundle (pa-backup) -> restoreBundle to its own new root with real personal-restore/1 report
dualFormatRestore.notHandWritten: no hand-written restore marker and no format relabeling; restored logical source fingerprint equals the verified snapshot
dualFormatRestore.review: each root gets a new 600 selection and a source driver verified-flow: candidate digest, history, sources verified, Work delivered, native_applied, business 422, held queue 1, provider unchanged
dualFormatRestore.independence: separate bundle, target root, consent and driver run per format; same data subject but different consumer/restore paths

uiInput.publishedConsumer: main 4b42a90 already consumes four states, seven reasons and withheld count; C does not claim the UI is missing and does not edit it

retained: narrow selection hides frozen body as scope_changed

layers.recovered: read-only snapshot restore only; no B business attach

limitations: package measured on the exact 0ede stage; later bytes need their own freeze and E binding
restore uses portability bundle wrapping each verified snapshot; it is not a launcher upgrade/rollback matrix
long-term revocation and concurrent writers unmeasured
no private permission, target startup, queue consumption or vendor native turn
